title: openmixer plugin catalog run, version 1
description: One qualification run: what openmixer measured about each audio plugin, on which package version, at which rate and quantum. A projection of the qualifier's hosting verdict (openmixer packages/plugin-qualify, classifyPluginHosting) and the console's /api/plugins rows. See plugin-catalog/README.md.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version. A reader refuses a file whose major version it does not know.

date.description: When the run's verdicts were read, ISO 8601 UTC.

source.description: qualify: the qualify job measured every plugin in this file. console: the verdicts were read from a running console's /api/plugins.

revision.description: The producer's source revision (git), or null when not known.

rig.description: The reference pace the verdicts were judged at.

policy.description: The thresholds a dimension had to meet, as the qualifier applied them.

cycleFloor.description: Load/run/unload cycles required before stability counts as measured.

soakSeconds.description: Soak length required before stability counts as measured.

coreFractionCeiling.description: Per-instance CPU limit, as a fraction of one core at the 95th percentile.

uri.description: LV2 plugin URI, or urn:clap:<id> for a CLAP plugin.

vendor.description: The plugin's declared author (LV2 doap author or maintainer) or CLAP vendor.

kind.description: From the plugin's own declared class. LV2: lv2:InstrumentPlugin is instrument; generator and utility classes are other; every processing class is effect. CLAP: feature instrument is instrument, else audio-effect is effect, else other.

declaredClass.description: What kind was derived from: the LV2 class label(s), or the CLAP feature list.

package.description: The installed package the measured binary came from, or null when no package owns it.

pluginVersion.description: The version the plugin declares itself (CLAP descriptor version), or null.

verdict.description: in-process: rated suitable on every dimension. isolated: rated conditional or unsuitable; runs in its own process. unknown: at least one dimension unmeasured; runs isolated. refused: the qualifier could not load or run it at all.

deciding.description: The code of the reason that decided a rating below suitable; null when suitable.

code.description: Stable code; never renamed within a schema version.

text.description: English rendering of code and params (schema/reason-texts.en.json).

hostingQuanta.description: Latency the hosting path adds, in quanta.

hostingMs.description: The same, in milliseconds at the run's rate and quantum.

coreFractionP95.description: CPU per instance, fraction of one core, 95th percentile; null when unmeasured.

incidents.description: Crashes, timeouts and load refusals observed during the run.
